name: Lien Finance
summary: BondMakerCollateralizedEth validated only the aggregate number of exception matches when exchanging bond groups, so repeated exception IDs could bypass per-bond multiset integrity and mint unbacked bonds. GeneralizedDotc and DecentralizedOTC then priced permissionlessly registered, attacker-crafted bond structures without validating their backing or economic shape, letting those bonds pull 542,144.628604 USDC from an LP allowance.
notes: Direct immutable BondMakerCollateralizedEth runtime deployed in this transaction and unchanged through the exploit; the prestate runtime contains no DELEGATECALL, SELFDESTRUCT, or CREATE2 instruction.
Direct immutable GeneralizedDotc runtime deployed in this transaction and unchanged through the exploit; the prestate runtime contains no DELEGATECALL, SELFDESTRUCT, or CREATE2 instruction.
Direct immutable DecentralizedOTC runtime deployed in this transaction and unchanged through the exploit; the prestate runtime contains no DELEGATECALL, SELFDESTRUCT, or CREATE2 instruction.

Exact pre-recovery victim depletion in the anchor receipt. Three USDC Transfer logs move 532,070.026484, 74.602120, and 10,000 USDC from LP 0xa961684a3a654fb2cca8f8991226c0cefc514d80 to the attack orchestrator, totaling 542,144.628604 USDC; a final transfer sweeps that exact amount to the attacker EOA. Stablecoin-par valuation excludes later recoveries and does not count attacker-supplied inputs.
Not the knot: one link of the conjunctive failure; the sibling with the latest age reset supplies the incident's single observation.
